lead.en: Display an operation as a loading shape that transitions into success or failure.
lead.zh: 用加载图形展示操作状态，并过渡到成功或失败。

rule.en: Choose dots, bars, ring or square. The host reports completion or failure.
rule.zh: 可选择圆点、竖条、圆环或方形；由宿主报告完成或失败。

when: Display an operation as a loading shape that transitions into success or failure.
not: Use determinate progress when a percentage is known.
en.apiLead: The host owns the operation. The footprint stays fixed; there is no completion event.

props.name: with_size
props.description: Positive finite size in px, on a 24-unit grid.

props.name: with_stroke_width
props.description: Ring, square and result width. Dots use 4; bars use 3.

props.name: with_tone
props.description: Use theme success and danger colors for results.

props.name: with_labels
props.description: Loading, success and error accessible labels.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Suppress the status role and label when a parent announces state.

props.name: set_variant
props.description: Dots, Bars, Ring or Square; retains the loop phase.

props.name: set_status
props.description: Host sets Loading, Success or Error. Repeated state is a no-op.

props.name: set_visible
props.description: Pause a mounted hidden view without accumulating hidden time.

props.name: variant / status
props.description: Read current state.

motion: Four curved strokes preserve velocity on retarget. Shape/result/upright critical springs use 0.46/0.52/0.60s, with 35ms result staggering.
Result scale follows 1 → 1.14 → 1 over 420ms. Reduced motion uses static geometry and stops the frame loop.
The gallery uses 72px and returns to loading after 1700ms; the installable control has no automatic reset timer.
ai: Use one stable ID and drive set_status from the actual request result.
Pause hidden mounted views with set_visible(false). Positive finite builder values preserve vector scaling.

when: 用加载图形展示操作状态，并过渡到成功或失败。
not: 已知百分比时使用确定进度。
zh.apiLead: 宿主拥有操作状态。控件尺寸固定，不发出完成事件。

props.name: with_size
props.description: 正有限数，单位 px；绘图使用 24 单位网格。

props.name: with_stroke_width
props.description: 圆环、方形与结果线宽。圆点宽4，竖条宽3。

props.name: with_tone
props.description: 结果使用主题的成功色和危险色。

props.name: with_labels
props.description: 加载、成功、失败的无障碍标签。

props.name: decorative
props.description: 父控件已播报状态时，关闭本控件的状态语义和标签。

props.name: set_variant
props.description: Dots、Bars、Ring 或 Square；保留循环相位。

props.name: set_status
props.description: 宿主设置 Loading、Success 或 Error；重复状态不重启动效。

props.name: set_visible
props.description: 暂停已挂载的隐藏视图，隐藏期间不累计动画时间。

props.name: variant / status
props.description: 读取当前状态。

motion: 四笔曲线在换目标时保留速度。形变／结果／回正的临界弹簧参数为 0.46／0.52／0.60s；结果逐笔错开 35ms。
结果在 420ms 内缩放 1 → 1.14 → 1。减少动效时显示静态几何并停止循环。
演示图形为 72px，1700ms 后复位；安装后的控件不包含自动复位计时器。
ai: 保持稳定 ID，用实际请求结果驱动 set_status。
已挂载但隐藏的视图调用 set_visible(false)。尺寸和线宽接收正有限数。

lead.en: A small animated mark for an assistant’s activity.
lead.zh: 用小型动画标记展示助手的当前状态。

rule.en: Supply task state, or omit it for a four-phase autoplay cycle.
rule.zh: 提供实际任务状态；不提供时自动循环四个阶段。

when: Show the activity of an assistant.
not: Use progress for known completion percentages.
en.apiLead: One Rust/GPUI control on desktop and Web. No action callback.

props.name: with_status / set_status
props.description: Explicit state disables autoplay. Writing is the generation phase.

props.name: with_variant
props.description: Mark, Pill or Avatar.

props.name: with_size
props.description: Positive finite px; avatar artwork is round(size × .56).

props.name: with_em_size / with_rem_size
props.description: Positive finite font-relative size; relative avatar artwork is size × .56.

props.name: with_tone
props.description: Accent, Foreground, Muted or Inherit.

props.name: with_color
props.description: Overrides tone. Error keeps its semantic danger color.

props.name: with_speed / set_speed
props.description: Finite loop speed; pose transitions and impulses use an independent clock.

props.name: with_twinkle / set_twinkle
props.description: Enable the idle twinkle.

props.name: with_paused / set_paused
props.description: Freeze artwork and the built-in cycle. Pill shimmer is independent.

props.name: with_announce
props.description: Status role; false selects a named Image role.

props.name: with_aria_label
props.description: Override the accessible name.

props.name: with_label
props.description: Override visible Pill text.

props.name: with_labels
props.default: Ready / Thinking / Writing / Done / Couldn't finish
props.description: Visible labels in state order.

props.name: with_aria_labels
props.default: AI ready / AI is thinking / AI is writing / AI finished / AI couldn't finish
props.description: Nonvisual state descriptions; localization extension.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Suppress the root role and name; KUI extension.

props.name: set_auto_play
props.description: Built-in dwell times: 1600 / 2800 / 3600 / 2000ms.

props.name: set_visible
props.description: Freeze hidden artwork and text; state timers remain independent.

props.name: status / is_auto_playing
props.description: Read effective activity and cycle setting.

motion: Pose mixes: Writing 420ms, Done 500ms, others 560ms, cubic-in-out. Interrupted mixtures keep moving and preserve angular velocity.
Idle 6.4s; Thinking 1.9s / 26°/s; Writing heartbeat 1.04s / 46°/s. Done gathers for 680ms; Error shakes for 460ms.
Pill: 28px high, text 13px / 18px, gap 8px, padding 7px / 12px. Label in 160ms, out 100ms; width spring 240ms.
Reduced: no loops, particles or impulses; pose mix 200ms, color fade 160ms, label fade 100ms. KUI rectangular radius stays 8px.
ai: Keep a stable ID. set_status disables autoplay even when the value is unchanged.
Demo Pause stops the state cycle, not the artwork. GPUI 0.3.10 lacks independent public aria-busy/live builders; screen-reader parity needs separate verification.

when: 展示助手的当前活动状态。
not: 已知完成百分比时使用进度组件。
zh.apiLead: 桌面与 Web 共用 Rust/GPUI 控件。Writing 表示生成阶段；没有动作回调。

props.name: with_status / set_status
props.description: 未设置；显式调用即进入受控状态，重复值也会停止自动循环，但不重新触发形变。

props.name: with_variant
props.description: Mark；另有 Pill、Avatar。

props.name: with_size
props.description: Mark 24px、Pill 16px、Avatar 32px。正有限数，不限制为12–128px。Avatar 图形为 round(size×.56)。

props.name: with_em_size / with_rem_size
props.description: 未设置；分别乘继承字号 / 根字号。相对尺寸的 Avatar 图形为 size×.56，光学提示使用实际图形像素的四舍五入值。

props.name: with_tone
props.description: Accent；另有 Foreground、Muted、Inherit。读取 KUI 语义色。

props.name: with_color
props.description: 未设置；覆盖 tone。Error 始终采用 danger72% + text_muted28% 的 Oklab 混色。

props.name: with_speed / set_speed
props.description: 1；仅接受有限数；控制循环时间和旋转目标速度，不改变状态混合、成功收拢或失败抖动的时钟。

props.name: with_twinkle / set_twinkle
props.description: true；控制 Idle 的缓慢闪烁。

props.name: with_paused / set_paused
props.description: false；暂停图形与内置状态轮播，恢复时从当前姿态继续。Pill 的独立文字微光不受此值控制。

props.name: with_announce
props.description: true：Status 角色；false：具名 Image 角色。

props.name: with_aria_label
props.description: 未设置；覆盖可访问名称。

props.name: with_label
props.description: 未设置；覆盖 Pill 文字，Mark / Avatar 不显示此文字。

props.name: with_labels
props.default: Ready / Thinking / Writing / Done / Couldn't finish
props.description: Ready / Thinking / Writing / Done / Couldn't finish。

props.name: with_aria_labels
props.default: AI ready / AI is thinking / AI is writing / AI finished / AI couldn't finish
props.description: AI ready / AI is thinking / AI is writing / AI finished / AI couldn't finish；KUI 本地化扩展。

props.name: decorative
props.description: false；true 移除根状态角色及名称，KUI 扩展。

props.name: set_auto_play
props.description: true；恢复时使用内置轮播的当前索引。

props.name: set_visible
props.description: true；宿主隐藏时冻结图形和文字微光；内置状态计时独立。

props.name: status / is_auto_playing
props.description: 读取有效状态 / 是否启用内置轮播。

motion: 姿态混合：Writing 420ms、Done 500ms、其他560ms，cubic-in-out；反切保留运动中的混合状态和角速度。
Idle 6.4s；Thinking 1.9s / 26°/s；Writing 心跳1.04s / 46°/s。Done 收拢680ms；Error 抖动460ms。
Pill 高28px、字号13px / 行高18px、间距8px、左右留白7px / 12px；文字入场160ms、离场100ms、宽度弹簧240ms。
减少动效：停止循环、粒子和冲击；姿态混合200ms、颜色160ms、文字100ms。KUI 矩形圆角保持8px。
ai: 保持稳定 ID。set_status 即使收到相同值，也退出自动轮播。
演示暂停只停止状态轮播。GPUI 0.3.10 没有独立 aria-busy/live 公开构建器，屏幕阅读器等价性需另验。
